quests.instruction: TAP THE ULTRASONIC CORE TO BRIEF CLARITY
quests.passage: [Acoustic Deep 91-1] Hydrothermal vents release toxic hydrogen sulfide minerals directly into the pitch-black ocean depths, creating a thriving habitat.
quests.question: What mineral compounds are released by deep hydrothermal vents?
quests.hint: Focus on the specific toxic minerals mentioned in the short vent passage. (Diving calibration index 91-1)
quests.explanation: The text explicitly states that hydrothermal vents release toxic hydrogen sulfide. [Verified by Radar Speed Check Unit 91].

quests.passage: [Sonic Vent 91-2] Bacteria perform chemosynthesis to convert chemicals into organic food, forming the absolute foundation of dark ecosystems.

quests.explanation: Deep bacteria rely on chemosynthesis to generate organic energy in complete darkness. [Verified by Radar Speed Check Unit 91].

quests.passage: [Radar Forest 91-3] Kelp forests grow upward towards solar rays at rates exceeding 60 centimeters a day using root-like holdfasts.
